Diploma thesis  ·  IHU  ·  June 2026

Development of a walking-robot leg

It starts with a real dog walking.

glTF 2.0, 31 frames, one gait cycle. Forward kinematics gives the toe path; Newton-Euler turns it into joint torques.

5.846 kg
robot mass
14.34 N
ground reaction per leg
1.355 N·m
peak torque vs 2.71 rated

Why servo. Fourier K=4 straight into Arduino C++, every joint independent, four legs give trot, walk and gallop. The Fourier cam came close at 2.85 mm, 93.6% better than the circular gears, but it needed eight coaxial cams.

Assumed. 2-D kinematics, ideal joints, one gait sample, walking only. The servo leg is designed, not built.

Broke. Servo splines stripped in PETG and Nylon. Low infill fractured. A stapled GT2 belt slipped, then snapped.

Next. Build the servo leg and verify the RMSE. Then four legs, IMU and ground-reaction sensors, a 3-D model.

More. GitHub: walking-robot-leg

Rear-brake duct study, 2026 regulations

FastF1 telemetry · Python thermal model · parametric CAD · FIA 2026 Regs, Section C, Issue 19

Parametric. Change an assumption in the thermal model and the geometry regenerates.

Not claimed. Sizing the duct needs CFD or a measured cooling correlation. Half-built, and shown as such.

Energy systems

EL HIERRO, CANARY ISLANDS

Wind, solar and battery sizing for an island grid

Python hourly model · REE grid data · ERA5 · PVGIS · Danish Energy Agency costs

El Hierro has no cable to the mainland and still burns diesel for about half its power. I rebuilt its grid hour by hour from about 210,000 operator readings, checked the wind model against the real wind farm (daily r = 0.84) and simulated 7,040 systems over every hour of the year.

The cheapest one, 1 wind turbine, 35 MWp of solar and an 80 MWh battery, supplies 97.5% of the island’s electricity at 65 EUR/MWh, against 196 for the diesel plant’s fuel and running cost alone. The existing plant stops at 45% because of grid stability, not a lack of wind.

Not claimed. Costs are European catalogue values, not quotes for the island, and the grid stability limit is inferred from the data, not a published rule.

More. GitHub: el-hierro-energy-study
